determinant_modes.name: galois_sigma2
determinant_modes.physical_contract: phase-cycled readout and software relabelling; not a complex-linear quantum gate

determinant_modes.name: galois_sigma3
determinant_modes.physical_contract: inverse phase-cycled readout and software relabelling; not a complex-linear quantum gate

determinant_modes.name: antiunitary_sigma4
determinant_modes.physical_contract: phase-reversed conjugate reference arm; covariance readout, not deterministic universal antiunitary dynamics

execution_order: apply or emulate the requested determinant-class covariance mode
measure p2 and p4 in matched signal/reference bins
reconstruct e4 exactly in the cyclotomic coefficient register
gate on the target e4 level
read the independent orientation parity latch

orientation_channel.frame_dependence: Requires the oriented icosahedral/Fano control frame and is not a characteristic-polynomial observable.
orientation_channel.observable: Moore-Dickson frame product prod_v c(v) in F5^x/{squares}
orientation_channel.role: Distinguishes the odd global switch after quartic fibre gating.

quartic_classifier.role: Exact classifier for the Pass-540 80-word spectral fibre.

safety_boundary: Determinant classes 2 and 3 are Galois-semilinear readout modes, and class 4 is an antiunitary covariance comparison. The overlay does not claim these are arbitrary deterministic quantum channels.
